Scroll planning intersects the row interior across the full inferred offset interval and viewport. It resets and verifies the top boundary before positioning, uses an observed thumb drag rather than a close-on-click track click, then re-observes before any final option click. Missing, split, mismatched, wrong-length, impossible, or stale thumb evidence refuses. The historical wrong V2 coordinate526 is explicitly rejected; observed safe target is approximately485.

Drag input first verifies the active production PID/window through owned_focus and client-origin pointer coordinates, proves primary-button-down with the reused XQueryPointer helper before and after motion, exceeds click threshold, and attempts mouseup in finally even when mousedown or held-button proof fails.
